concept: HA: ASG and ALB across multiple AZs
tests: How to design a web tier that survives the failure of an entire Availability Zone.
expected: Auto Scaling group and ALB in at least two AZs. Triggers: "remain available if an entire AZ fails", "Auto Scaling group behind an ALB".
why_not: Everything in one AZ with a standby — single point of failure; an Elastic IP failover script — brittle; Multi-AZ RDS does not protect the web tier.
